publicContract.constructor: InstallCutoverController(runtime_root, task_adapter, pythonw_path, process_adapter=None, security_adapter=None, boundary_hook=None)
publicContract.stage: stage(manifest, source_root, installed_root, authority, observed_at) -> INSTALL_STAGE_RESULT_V1
publicContract.inspect: inspect() -> INSTALL_INSPECTION_V1 with no secret-bearing inputs or diagnostics
publicContract.errors: PrivilegeDenied is preserved or wrapped as typed InstallControlError; InstallControlError exposes exact .reason

durableDesign.journal: canonical UTF-8 JSON with schemaVersion=INSTALL_CUTOVER_JOURNAL_V1, authority binding/hash, source identity/hash, installed identity/hash, exact old preimage plus hash, structured candidate Task definition, phase and journalSha256
durableDesign.writeRule: atomic temp-write, flush/fsync, os.replace and parent-directory flush for every phase; parse/exact-key/type/semantic/canonical-round-trip/hash validate before any resume mutation
durableDesign.corruption: unknown/missing/extra key or phase, hash/authority/preimage/path drift fails closed with no task or installed mutation
durableDesign.idempotency: stage/cutover/rollback reopen the journal and resume; completed filesystem copy, register, disable, enable or restore operation is never repeated

manifestAndTask.canonicalManifest: tracked NEWS_GRASP_CONTROL_MANIFEST_V1 exact top/task/action/trigger keys; one News-Grasp Production task; triggers scheduled-0600 and audit-0640; unknown/missing nested key fails closed
manifestAndTask.taskDefinition: exact TASK_DEFINITION_V1 mapping: taskPath,taskName,enabled=false,executable=pythonw_path,arguments=manifest action argv in order,workingDirectory=runtime_root,triggers exact,multipleInstancesPolicy exact
manifestAndTask.stageInvariant: stage copies launcher.pyw with exact bytes/hash, registers candidate disabled exactly once, and returns old enabled/new disabled; if initial state is new-only or both its first mutation disables new, then it may enable old; both-disabled enables old; stage never disables old, enables new or calls cutover
manifestAndTask.cutoverInvariant: disable old before enable new; every mutation snapshot has dual-enabled zero; Pull and Inventory remain disabled and are never deleted
manifestAndTask.rollbackInvariant: capture and seal the exact old definition before stage; rollback disables new before restoring and enabling that exact preimage; every crash/retry converges to old-only

hookContract.rule: invoke each named hook at its durable boundary exactly as sealed tests expect; a hook crash propagates before the next irreversible operation and retry resumes safely

securityContract.authority: exact INSTALL_AUTHORITY_V1, authoritySha256 canonical binding, issueDate/generation/sourceRoot/sourceSha256; source root and launcher must remain under the authorized resolved root
securityContract.path: reject traversal, absolute working-directory escape, reparse, source identity change between capture/verify, content hash drift, insecure ACL and untrusted pythonw signer before task/install mutation
securityContract.adapter: use injected public security_adapter capture_identity/verify_identity/is_reparse/acl_is_secure/signer_is_trusted; default adapter must provide equivalent fail-closed checks without subprocess
securityContract.secretArgv: reject control bytes, shell metacharacters, secret-looking argv/diagnostics, unknown keys and non-token argv; diagnostics never echo secret values
securityContract.outside: no operation resolves outside runtime/source/installed authorized roots

humanImpact.processAdapter: when a process_adapter is supplied, stage runs one installed canary after exact byte installation and before pointer durability; launch ordered argv with shell=false, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, encoding=utf-8, includeChildTree=true, noFocusTheft=true, noAutoOpen=true, noUserMonitoring=true; a missing adapter never falls back to visible subprocess

inspectionContract.required: exact INSTALL_INSPECTION_V1 including phase, dualEnabledCount=0, autoDeletedPullTaskCount=0, focusTheftCount=0, sharedProcessKillCount=0 and sealed installed/task hashes
inspectionContract.readOnly: inspect performs no task, filesystem, process or journal mutation and contains no source authority secret or argv secret
